description: Architecture Anchor Registry. Phase 8A + Phase 8C Runtime Integration. 不修改 production code, 仅在 v1-experimental 范围内提供 in-context reference 加载入口. Anchor 的 source-of-truth 仍是各 brand 子目录的 metadata.yaml + architecture-dna-analysis.yaml; registry 是面向 prompt compiler 的 manifest. Phase 8C 在原 Phase 8A 基础上加 category + strength 字段, 供 selectAnchors 自动选择使用.

anchors.primaryMechanism: 层叠半透明介质从天花垂落, 在中心汇合形成夹层光, 边缘缓慢过渡为墙, 无硬收边
anchors.secondaryMechanism: 金属长方体接待台配顶底发光缝, 与暖色环境形成对比

anchors.primaryMechanism: 窄框整面玻璃幕墙 + 短走廊缓冲, 街道与室内形成视觉连续
anchors.secondaryMechanism: 弧形连续天花 + 浅木流线形接待台, 由低向高的空间序列

anchors.primaryMechanism: 单层大跨膜天花 + 中心天窗, 跨工位连续覆盖, 自然光通过半透明介质柔化后落下
anchors.secondaryMechanism: 整面 3 大格落地玻璃 + 弧形膜切分工位, 维持视觉连续 + 听觉弱屏蔽

loaders.fieldMechanismsOnly: loader/load-anchors.mjs :: loadArchitectureAnchors(brandKey) returns mechanism strings, no image bytes
loaders.inContextReference: loader/load-anchors.mjs :: loadAnchorsAsInContextReference(brandKey) returns compact list with image path (for runtime use, not for prompt text)
loaders.automaticSelection: loader/load-anchors.mjs :: selectAnchors(brandKey, criteria) Phase 8C: scores anchors by industry / sceneType / commercialContext / functional realism, returns top-K

inContextPolicy.preferredOrder: by role coverage: exterior -> interior_reception -> consultation_floor -> corridor -> vip_lounge -> product_display -> treatment -> lobby
inContextPolicy.fallbackBehavior: if a brand has no anchors, return empty list; prompt compiler degrades to v1.1 + Phase 8B.1 baseline (11 blocks, no architecture_context block)
